title: Six Flags Magic Mountain
description: The Signature Magic Mountain-inspired design is an original Signature concept called Summit Thrill Park, a hillside park whose headliner is an original hybrid coaster named the Twin Timber Tempest, drawn as two wooden-style tracks braided into one steel spine. Its family land is an original cartoon-free meadow village, and its summit walk is an original quiet-trail design. This is a Signature-original design inspired by the idea of a hillside thrill park, never a copy of the real park.
lands_areas: Bugs Bunny World, DC Universe, Thrill Capital areas, Samurai Summit, The Underground
rides_new: NEW (operating): Twisted Colossus (hybrid coaster); Tatsu (flying coaster); X2 (4D coaster); Full Throttle (launched coaster); Goliath (steel coaster)
theming_ecosystems: Thrill-capital theming: superhero districts, a mountain summit village, and a cartoon family land sharing one hillside park

demo.code:

    ('X2', 50),
    ('Full Throttle', 35),
    ('Goliath', 30),
]

description: The Signature Great Adventure-inspired design is an original Signature concept called Pine Barrens Adventure Park, pairing an original drive-through animal preserve with an original wooden coaster named the Jersey Pine Flyer and an original single-rail design named the Needle Thread. lands_areas: Main Street, Frontier Adventures, Movie Town, Golden Kingdom, Plaza del Carnaval, The Boardwalk
rides_new: NEW (operating): El Toro (wooden coaster); Nitro (steel coaster); Jersey Devil Coaster (single-rail coaster); Batman The Ride (inverted coaster); Superman Ultimate Flight (flying coaster)
rides_past: PAST: Kingda Ka (2005-2024); Green Lantern (2011-2024); Rolling Thunder (1979-2013)

demo.code:

    ('Nitro', 9, 40),

]
print('One-day itinerary: Six Flags Great Adventure')

This is a Signature-original design inspired by the idea of a colonial-America park, never a record of the real park.
lands_areas: Main Street 1776, Olde Boston, Nantucket, Coyote Creek, Gotham City, Metropolis, Looney Tunes Movie Town
rides_new: NEW (operating): Superman: Ride of Steel (steel coaster); Batwing (flying coaster); Joker's Jinx (launched coaster); Wild One (wooden coaster); Roar (wooden coaster)
rides_past: PAST: Two Face: The Flip Side (1999-2007); Apocalypse (2012-2018); Wild World-era rides (retired across the decades)
theming_ecosystems: Colonial-America theming: a 1776 main street, an old Boston district, a Nantucket harbor area, a western creek town, and superhero cities
hidden_spots: Publicly-known hidden spots: the shaded Nantucket harbor paths, the quiet corners of Olde Boston, and the back walkways of Coyote Creek

demo.code:
RIDES = [
    ('Superman: Ride of Steel', 45),
    ('Batwing', 30),
    ("Joker's Jinx", 30),
    ('Wild One', 25),
    ('Roar', 30),
]
print('Wait-time estimate: Six Flags America')
total = 0
for name, wait in RIDES:
    total += wait
    print('%s: %d min' % (name, wait))
print('Rides listed: %d' % len(RIDES))
print('Total queue time if ridden once each: %d min' % total)
print('Average wait: %.1f min' % (total / len(RIDES)))
longest = max(RIDES, key=lambda r: r[1])
print('Longest wait: %s at %d min' % longest)
demo.expected_output:
Wait-time estimate: Six Flags America
Superman: Ride of Steel: 45 min
Batwing: 30 min
Joker's Jinx: 30 min
Wild One: 25 min
Roar: 30 min
Rides listed: 5
Total queue time if ridden once each: 160 min
Average wait: 32.0 min
Longest wait: Superman: Ride of Steel at 45 min

title: Six Flags Qiddiya City
description: The Signature Qiddiya-inspired design is an original Signature concept called Desert Thrill City Park, an original desert entertainment-city park whose headliner is an original record-scale coaster named the Falcon Desert Dive, drawn without copying any announced layout. This is a Signature-original design inspired by the idea of a desert thrill city, never a record of the real announced park.
status: FUTURE — announced park; opening timing per official announcements; this record describes announced plans, not an operating visit
lands_areas: Announced districts: City of Thrills, Discovery Springs, Steam Town, Twilight Gardens, Valley of Fortune, Grand Exposition
rides_new: NEW (operating): Falcon's Flight (announced steel coaster); Spitfire (announced coaster); Iron Rattler, announced namesake (announced coaster); Twilight Gardens family coaster (announced family coaster); Discovery Springs water coaster (announced water coaster)
rides_past: PAST: No retired rides: this is a future park with no operating history yet; Announced plans may change before opening; verify against official announcements
theming_ecosystems: Announced theming: a city-of-thrills district, discovery springs, a steam town, twilight gardens, a valley of fortune, and a grand exposition
hidden_spots: Publicly-known hidden spots: none yet — hidden spots for a future park can only be described after opening; this record lists none rather than inventing any

demo.code:
RIDES = [
    ("Falcon's Flight", 10, 60),
    ('Spitfire', 9, 40),
    ('Iron Rattler, announced namesake', 8, 35),
    ('Twilight Gardens family coaster', 6, 20),
    ('Discovery Springs water coaster', 7, 25),
]
print('One-day itinerary: Six Flags Qiddiya City')
plan = sorted(RIDES, key=lambda r: -r[1])
clock = 10 * 60
for name, thrill, wait in plan:
    hh, mm = divmod(clock, 60)
    print('%02d:%02d ride %s (thrill %d/10, wait %d min)' % (hh, mm, name, thrill, wait))
    clock += wait + 15
hh, mm = divmod(clock, 60)
print('Plan ends about %02d:%02d after %d rides' % (hh, mm, len(plan)))
demo.expected_output:
One-day itinerary: Six Flags Qiddiya City
10:00 ride Falcon's Flight (thrill 10/10, wait 60 min)
11:15 ride Spitfire (thrill 9/10, wait 40 min)
12:10 ride Iron Rattler, announced namesake (thrill 8/10, wait 35 min)
13:00 ride Discovery Springs water coaster (thrill 7/10, wait 25 min)
13:40 ride Twilight Gardens family coaster (thrill 6/10, wait 20 min)
Plan ends about 14:15 after 5 rides

title: Six Flags Astroworld

This is a Signature-original design inspired by the idea of a big Texas fairground park, never a record of the real Astroworld.
lands_areas: Former areas: a frontier area, a water area, show areas, and a central lagoon midway
rides_new: OPERATING: none — past park or past coaster; historical headliner noted in the demo.
rides_past: PAST: Texas Cyclone (1976-2005); Ultra Twister (1990-2005); XLR-8 (1984-2005); Greezed Lightnin' (1978-2005); Viper (1989-2005)
theming_ecosystems: Former theming: a big Texas fairground park beside a domed stadium, with bright signage and a skyline of tall rides
hidden_spots: Publicly-known hidden spots: regulars recalled quiet corners near the lagoon and shaded paths away from the main midway; nothing of the park remains to visit

title: Six Flags New Orleans
description: The Signature New Orleans-inspired design is an original Signature concept called Jazz Lagoon Park, with an original French Quarter-style district and jazz stages plus an original wooden coaster named the Bayou Zephyr, drawn without copying any real layout. This is a Signature-original design inspired by the idea of a jazz-city park, never a record of the real park.
status: PAST — closed after Hurricane Katrina in 2005; site not operating as a park
lands_areas: Former areas: a French Quarter area, a jazz district, a bayou area, and a midway around a lagoon
rides_new: OPERATING: none — past park or past coaster; historical headliner noted in the demo.
rides_past: PAST: Mega Zeph (2000-2005); Batman The Ride (2003-2005, later relocated); Jester (2003-2005, later relocated); Zydeco Scream (2000-2005); Jazzland-era rides (2000-2002)
theming_ecosystems: Former theming: a New Orleans jazz and French Quarter park, opened in 2000 as Jazzland and operated as Six Flags New Orleans from 2002
hidden_spots: Publicly-known hidden spots: none visitable — the site has not operated as a park since 2005; former visitors recalled the shaded lagoon paths

demo.code:
NEW = [
    'Mega Zeph site ride (historical)',
]
PAST = ['Mega Zeph (2000-2005)', 'Batman The Ride (2003-2005, later relocated)', 'Jester (2003-2005, later relocated)', 'Zydeco Scream (2000-2005)', 'Jazzland-era rides (2000-2002)']

print('Listed share: %.1f%%' % (len(NEW) / total * 100.0))
